text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Israeli newspapers on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Head of military intelligence: Arafat will resort to violence if chances for Palestinian state fade.
- Labour's Peres and Barak will meet in bid to prevent conflict at party convention.
- Israel considering establishing city council for "greater Jerusalem" including Jewish settlements in the area.
- Wiesel declines post with Swiss humanitarian fund.
- Army chief: the internal split in Israel concerns me more than Syria's missiles.
- Jordan says water crisis with Israel resolved.
- Peres: the Labour party is falling prey to dictatorship.
- Netanyahu to begin consultating aides on final status of West Bank, Gaza Strip.
- Israeli security sources say Palestinian Authority behind killing of Palestinian land dealer.
